title: Modeling Complex Systems
description: Building conceptual and quantitative models to understand how health and social systems behave over time, especially when outcomes depend on feedback, implementation, and local context.

subareas.title: HIV Stigma & Service Engagement
subareas.description: Developing systems models that connect stigma, healthcare engagement, and prevention behaviors, including causal loop diagrams and quantitative dynamic models.

subareas.title: Maternal Health & Service Delivery Redesign
subareas.description: Modeling maternal and neonatal health interventions in Kenya, with a focus on how implementation design, referral systems, and health-system constraints shape outcomes.

subareas.title: Qualitative-to-Quantitative Translation
subareas.description: Translating conceptual and qualitative systems work into quantitative models that can be used for simulation, evaluation, and decision-making.

featuredProjects.title: Visualizing Stigma and HIV Service Engagement
featuredProjects.venue: Participatory systems modeling and quantitative translation

featuredProjects.title: Service Delivery Redesign Modeling in Kenya
featuredProjects.venue: Maternal and neonatal health systems modeling

title: Data & Inference
description: Using statistical modeling, estimation, and reweighting methods to learn from incomplete or biased health data and produce more decision-relevant population estimates.

subareas.title: Population Estimation
subareas.description: Estimating MSM populations and related demographic distributions using survey data, ACS data, and simulation-based methods.

subareas.title: Reweighting & Bias Correction
subareas.description: Applying IPF, raking, and related methods to align nonprobability samples with target populations and improve downstream inference.

subareas.title: Survey-Based Estimation
subareas.description: Working with repeated cross-sectional and observational health datasets to estimate latent or hard-to-measure quantities.

featuredProjects.title: Reweighting AMIS Data for Population-Level Inference
featuredProjects.venue: Bias correction and calibration for health surveys

title: Decision Support & Tools
description: Designing outputs that make complex analyses usable for real-world decision-making, including dashboards, stakeholder-facing tools, and intervention-focused evaluation frameworks.

subareas.title: Dashboards & Stakeholder Tools
subareas.description: Building interfaces and decision tools that help partners explore model results, compare scenarios, and understand uncertainty.

subareas.title: Funding & Intervention Evaluation
subareas.description: Using models and quantitative analysis to support strategic decisions about which interventions to fund, scale, or prioritize.

subareas.title: Participatory Decision Support
subareas.description: Integrating stakeholder knowledge into model design and interpretation so outputs are more aligned with real implementation contexts.

featuredProjects.title: Maternal Health Decision Dashboard
featuredProjects.venue: Scenario-based decision support for health systems

featuredProjects.title: Intervention Evaluation for Public Health Funding Decisions
